verdict.rationale: BILL's own marketing says its cards come with spend management so that "every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant." Developer docs also mention budgets and virtual cards, which loosely suggests spend limits. Nothing in the pack documents restrictions by merchant, category or amount, or that out-of-policy charges are declined at the point of sale. missing for 10: documented merchant restrictions, category (MCC) restrictions, per-card amount limits, point-of-sale decline or auto-lock behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale
